runtime_project_commit_note: Not reliably recorded in the original artifacts. Do not substitute the archive or current source commit.

dev_dataset.note: Current repository dataset hash recorded during archiving; this hash was not captured at original execution time.

purpose: Deployment, padding optimization, microbatch, concurrency and checkpoint smoke checks; not formal training
environment_notes: environment/versions.txt records client package versions plus the GPU and SkyRL commit; it is not a complete server environment lockfile.
The archived vLLM startup log identifies server vLLM 0.33.0.
Historical training configs are the files present at collection time. t64_mb1p/config.json reflects the resumed run; it is not a separate config snapshot for each step.

derived_files.step_timings.csv: Direct extraction of time/total, time/sampling, time/train_step, tokens/trained, KL and entropy from saved metrics rows. Missing fields remain blank.
derived_files.server_stage_timings.csv: Extract lines matching process_batch_requests(OP, n=N) took Ss from the five named server logs. Batch request counts are not datum counts.
derived_files.training/examples.jsonl: First saved t64_mb1p occurrence of each available outcome: completed_correct, completed_incorrect, max_turns, parse_error, max_tokens. Ordered source iteration paths and source line numbers define selection.
